title: Unmatched home rows and NULL dimension keys form a NULL group
question: What is the sales amount by customer region?
behavior: The branch LEFT JOINs customers from store_sales. SS4 has no customer, and SS5's customer C3 has a NULL region, so both amounts are in the NULL region group (25 + 40). An INNER JOIN would drop SS4 and leave 40. Section 6, S1.
